fact: Semaglutide and tirzepatide are GLP-1-based therapies that enable effective control of glucose and weight loss, while reducing cardiovascular and renal morbidity and mortality in people with type 2 diabetes and obesity.
fact_zh: 司美格鲁肽和替西帕肽是GLP-1类药物，能够有效控制血糖和体重减轻，同时减少2型糖尿病和肥胖患者的 cardiovascular 和肾脏发病率和死亡率。
quote: Glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1)-based therapies, such as semaglutide and tirzepatide, represent highly effective treatment options for people with type 2 diabetes and obesity, enabling effective control of glucose and weight loss, while reducing cardiovascular and renal morbidity and mortality.

fact: Next-generation GLP-1-based drugs are being developed to promise greater weight loss, improved tolerability and additional options for the route and frequency of dosing.
fact_zh: 下一代GLP-1类药物正在开发中，有望实现更大的体重减轻，改善耐受性，并提供更多给药途径和频率的选择。
quote: The success of these medicines has spurred development of next-generation GLP-1-based drugs, promising greater weight loss, improved tolerability and additional options for the route and frequency of dosing.

fact: Structurally unique GLP-1-based medicines that achieve substantially greater and rapid weight loss may impact musculoskeletal health.
fact_zh: 结构独特的GLP-1类药物，能够实现显著更大和更快的体重减轻，可能会影响骨骼肌肉健康。
quote: Structurally unique GLP-1-based medicines that achieve substantially greater and rapid weight loss may impact musculoskeletal health, providing a rationale for therapeutics that more selectively target adipose tissue loss while preserving muscle mass and strength.

fact: Ongoing clinical trials in peripheral vascular disease, neuropsychiatric and substance use disorders, metabolic liver disease, arthritis, hypertension and neurodegenerative disorders may broaden indications for GLP-1-based therapeutics.
fact_zh: 正在进行的外周血管疾病、神经精神和物质使用障碍、代谢性肝病、关节炎、高血压和神经退行性疾病的临床试验可能会扩大GLP-1类药物的适应症。
quote: Ongoing clinical trials in peripheral vascular disease, neuropsychiatric and substance use disorders, metabolic liver disease, arthritis, hypertension and neurodegenerative disorders may broaden indications for GLP-1-based therapeutics.

fact: GLP-1-based therapies are being optimized for pharmacokinetics and tolerability, engagement of new therapeutically useful pathways and safety aspects.
fact_zh: GLP-1类药物正在优化药代动力学和耐受性，参与新的治疗上有用的通路和安全性方面。
quote: This Review profiles established and emerging GLP-1-based medicines, discussing optimization of pharmacokinetics and tolerability, engagement of new therapeutically useful pathways and safety aspects.
